decisive_items: Dermal neutrophilia and microabscesses with eosinophilia
response.rationale: Vegetative lesions with pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia and eosinophil-containing dermal microabscesses favor a vegetative form of pyoderma gangrenosum over Sweet syndrome, which lacks these epidermal and eosinophilic features, and over eczema herpeticum, which lacks viral cytopathic change.

rejected.why: No vesicular lesions, multinucleated giant cells, or viral cytopathic effect are described; negative HIV and PAS staining do not support eczema herpeticum.
Sweet syndrome typically shows diffuse dermal neutrophilia with edema but not pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia or vegetating/keloidal plaques; eosinophilic microabscesses favor pyoderma gangrenosum.
